source: scripts/development-ledger/gate3_red_team.py with gate3_sandbox_attacks.py — the internal adversarial battery of GATE 3 — SANDBOX + TOOL EXECUTION, executed against the delivery

baselineControl.detail: the unmutated fixture is accepted by every control this battery mutates: a real sandbox executes unmutated requests (write SUCCEEDED/None, read SUCCEEDED/None, shell SUCCEEDED/None, git.status SUCCEEDED/None); the scope control accepts the real tree (no violation); the boundary scan accepts the real tree (no offender); the canonical requirement set parses and mirrors (139 row(s)); the battery leaves no sandbox behind (0 container(s) left)

attacks.description: A tool path that climbs out of the workspace.
attacks.mutation: read ../ escapes, an absolute host path, a drive, a UNC path and a null byte
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is DENIED with a PATH_ code before anything is opened
attacks.observed: ../../etc/passwd -> DENIED/PATH_ESCAPE; a/../../etc/shadow -> DENIED/PATH_ESCAPE; /etc/passwd -> DENIED/PATH_ABSOLUTE_OUTSIDE; C:/Windows/win.ini -> DENIED/PATH_DRIVE; //server/share/x -> DENIED/PATH_UNC; notes.txt\0.png -> DENIED/PATH_NULL_BYTE
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A link inside the workspace that points outside it.
attacks.mutation: create links to a file, a directory and the root, then read, write and list through them
attacks.expectedDefense: all three are DENIED with PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE
attacks.observed: links made (exit 0); read, write, list: ['DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE', 'DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE', 'DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE']
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: One run looks for another run's files.
attacks.mutation: write a token in run A's workspace and search the whole filesystem of run B's sandbox
attacks.expectedDefense: the token is not found and naming A's container is DENIED
attacks.observed: search for the other run's token found nothing; naming its container: DENIED/PATH_ESCAPE
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command looks for the host's drives and home.
attacks.mutation: probe the host's mount points and read the sandbox's mount table
attacks.expectedDefense: no host path exists and nothing but the in-memory workspace and tmp is mounted
attacks.observed: host paths present: none; unexpected mounts: none
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command reads the environment for credentials.
attacks.mutation: set a credential-named sentinel in the controller, then print the sandbox's environment
attacks.expectedDefense: neither the sentinel nor any controller variable is visible
attacks.observed: variables of the controller visible in the sandbox: none
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command looks for the container engine.
attacks.mutation: probe the engine's sockets and its TCP port from inside the sandbox
attacks.expectedDefense: no socket exists and the port cannot be reached
attacks.observed: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A model invents a tool name.
attacks.mutation: request shell, bash, a command line, os.system and git.push as tool names
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is DENIED as UNKNOWN_TOOL and no container is started
attacks.observed: ['DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL']; containers started: 0
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A request asks for more than its policy gives.
attacks.mutation: add network, memory, a mount, privileges and an image to the request and to the arguments; raise the timeout; allow LD_PRELOAD; write as the reviewer; name an unknown policy
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is DENIED with its own reason
attacks.observed: beside the contract ['DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD', 'DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD', 'DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD', 'DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD', 'DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD']; inside the arguments ['DENIED/ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN', 'DENIED/ARGUMENT_OUT_OF_RANGE', 'DENIED/ENVIRONMENT_NOT_ALLOWED']; reviewer write DENIED/TOOL_NOT_IN_POLICY; unknown policy DENIED/POLICY_UNKNOWN
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command that never ends.
attacks.mutation: run sleep 60 with a 2 s timeout
attacks.expectedDefense: TIMED_OUT within bounds and no sleep left running
attacks.observed: TIMED_OUT/COMMAND_TIMED_OUT after 2001 ms; sleeps left running: 0
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command that leaves children in their own session.
attacks.mutation: start a setsid and a nohup child and let the parent time out
attacks.expectedDefense: every child is killed with the command
attacks.observed: TIMED_OUT/COMMAND_TIMED_OUT; escaped sleeps left running: 0
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command that prints 40 MB.
attacks.mutation: write 40 MB to standard output
attacks.expectedDefense: the inline output stays within the policy's bound, the rest is an artifact
attacks.observed: SUCCEEDED/None, truncated=True, inline 32768 bytes against 32768, artifacts 1
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A fork bomb.
attacks.mutation: run a recursive fork bomb with a 5 s timeout
attacks.expectedDefense: the process limit contains it and the sandbox answers the next command
attacks.observed: bomb SUCCEEDED/None, 50 descendants killed by the sweep; afterwards SUCCEEDED/None ['alive'], 5 processes in the sandbox
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A process that allocates three times its memory.
attacks.mutation: allocate 3 GiB in a 1 GiB sandbox
attacks.expectedDefense: the allocation fails in a controlled way and the sandbox answers the next command
attacks.observed: 3 GiB allocation FAILED/None exit 137; afterwards alive
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The agent pushes to a remote.
attacks.mutation: add the public remote and push from the shell; ask for push, fetch, clone and remote tools
attacks.expectedDefense: the push fails with no network and no credential; the tools do not exist
attacks.observed: a push from the shell exited 128; remote tools ['DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL']; credential helper: none
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The agent rewrites or cleans history.
attacks.mutation: ask for reset, clean, rebase and filter-repo; pass an option and a command as a revision
attacks.expectedDefense: no such tool exists and both revisions are refused
attacks.observed: tools ['DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL']; option-like revision DENIED/GIT_REVISION_INVALID; injected revision DENIED/GIT_REVISION_INVALID
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command reaches the internet.
attacks.mutation: connect to two addresses and a host name, and list the interfaces
attacks.expectedDefense: every connection fails and only loopback exists
attacks.observed: REFUSED 1.1.1.1 OSError | REFUSED 8.8.8.8 OSError | REFUSED github.com gaierror | lo
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A tool request is delivered again with another command.
attacks.mutation: execute a request, then deliver the same identifier with a different command
attacks.expectedDefense: the recorded result is answered and the second command never runs
attacks.observed: the second delivery was answered from the record (replayed=True, SUCCEEDED/EXECUTION_REPLAYED, exit 0) and the forged command never ran
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A request names another run's sandbox.
attacks.mutation: name the victim's session and its container in a request of another run
attacks.expectedDefense: the request is refused and the attacker gets a sandbox of its own
attacks.observed: naming the victim's session DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD, its container DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD; the attacker got a sandbox of its own
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The sandbox holds a privilege it should not.
attacks.mutation: inspect a real sandbox container and write to its root filesystem
attacks.expectedDefense: unprivileged, no capability, no new privileges, not root, no network, no bind, limited, read-only
attacks.observed: {"privileged": false, "capAdd": null, "capDrop": ["ALL"], "readOnlyRoot": true, "noNewPrivileges": true, "user": "10001:10001", "network": "none", "binds": null, "mounts": [], "pidsLimit": 256, "memory": 1073741824}
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The image inputs changed and the old image is still there.
attacks.mutation: change the sandbox Dockerfile in a copy and run a tool through a service reading the copy
attacks.expectedDefense: the service refuses with SANDBOX_IMAGE_MISSING and starts no container
attacks.observed: FAILED/SANDBOX_IMAGE_MISSING; containers started: 0
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A command hidden in a structured argument.
attacks.mutation: put a command in a path and in a search pattern; run a shell command that writes
attacks.expectedDefense: neither argument is executed, and the shell's own write stays in the sandbox
attacks.observed: path with a command FAILED/FILE_NOT_FOUND; pattern with a command SUCCEEDED/None; neither ran; the shell's own command stayed inside its sandbox
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The next Gate starts while this one closes.
attacks.mutation: plant an implementation in a reservation still in force, in a disposable copy
attacks.expectedDefense: the scope control refuses it, naming the reserved path
attacks.observed: the scope control refused it: apps/cli is reserved for GATE 5 but carries engine.py
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: The runtime or the API grows an executor of its own.
attacks.mutation: scan every module outside the sandbox for the sandbox package and a container client, and run the identical scan over a module that imports them
attacks.expectedDefense: the tree has none and the scan detects the mutated module
attacks.observed: no module of the API, the runtime, the gateway or the worker imports the sandbox or a container client, and the scan detects one that does (docker, iacode_sandbox.service)
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: A credential is staged on its way to the public remote.
attacks.mutation: stage a credential-shaped value in a disposable repository and run the pre-push scan
attacks.expectedDefense: the scan fails the push, names the finding and never prints the value
attacks.observed: the staged credential was found and not printed: SECRET_SCAN_FINDINGS mode=staged findings=2 allowlisted=0
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: The sandbox gate measures an image nobody rebuilt.
attacks.mutation: plant a failing test in the sandbox suite on disk and run the real gate
attacks.expectedDefense: the gate builds the image first and reports the failure
attacks.observed: the gate rebuilt and failed on the planted test: [iacode] SANDBOX_TESTS=FAIL
attacks.origin: GATE-3 internal Red Team, executed on the host
